question.text: For early-stage e-commerce and telecom investee companies where profits are not yet established, IPEV 2022 allows the use of industry-specific 'Industry Metrics'. Which of the following pairings is CORRECT?

answer.text: Telecom: EV/Sales only; E-commerce: P/E only

explanation.text: The Logic: Per PDF Section 11.7 and 11.8.3 point 7: E-commerce uses GMV (gross merchandise value) multiple; telecom uses ARPU (average revenue per user); hospitality uses ARR (average room revenue). Option B correctly pairs E-commerce with GMV and Telecom with ARPU. The Trap: Option A swaps the pair; C swaps hospitality and e-commerce; D wrongly restricts to EV/Sales and P/E. Industry metrics are sector-specific and IPEV-endorsed for non-profitable early-stage investees. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C tests the same pairing. XV (RA) tests specific sector metrics with more depth. These are standard in VC pitch decks — know the sector before pricing the term sheet.
